value.rationale: Stochastic logistic moment-closure formulas can share identical mean/variance for radically different actual Markov-chain stationary behavior. The one-sided tail criterion and explicit equal-variance non-Gaussian pair isolate a mathematically motivated support effect and a precise limitation of noise-variance-only persistence reasoning. Not just a Gaussian repetition: the proof covers every iid law with unbounded negative support and finite second moment for every r>0.
residual_risks: Biological interpretation requires nonnegative or absorbed state, not treated here.

final_claim: For any r>0 exact additive-noise real logistic recursion and iid innovations with finite second moment and unbounded negative support, every finite trajectory tends to -infinity almost surely and no real-line invariant probability exists; small bounded noise may sustain positive stationary law even with exactly matched mean and variance.
limitations: Real-valued exact recursion; no reflection, truncation or absorption at zero.
Positive bounded-noise uniqueness holds within invariant interval J only, not all R.
The quartic describes formal Gaussian moment closure, not real invariant distributions.
